positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Deployed and managed microservices using Golang, Docker, Kubernetes, Pub/Sub Messaging, BigQuery, and Google Cloud Services to create ETL pipelines to process user data
-Created external-facing web applications using React.js, Node.js, and the Stripe API  to collect data on users funneled through ad campaigns, process payment information, and send SMS notifications.

- Developed an internal-facing Phone Dialer application, a full stack web application created using Vue.js, PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Docker, and the Twilio API, to organize 10,000+ potential leads and streamlined the process of contacting the leads. This in turn increased revenue from sales and marketing campaigns by 15%.

-Deployed and maintained web servers using Digital Ocean and AWS to create testing environments to evaluate code.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Created Kubernetes microservices using Node.js to pipe the number of net new users on the mobile application and related metadata (eg. revenue, demographics, etc), each payload being ~10 GB of data. This in turn allowed us to better gauge the health of the company.

-Developed the front-end for the chocolate check-out interface using React Native 

-Developed flexible backend using Google's NoSQL Firestore database

-Worked in a startup environment (three engineers, 1 product manager, and 1 designer) to build and maintain the mobile app

volunteerExperiences.description:

-Directed the entire organization of HackDartmouth which included 5 teams in Marketing, Operations/Finance, Developers, Design, and Sponsorship

-Worked closely with designers to implement design and branding decisions into the website
-Hosted workshops to Dartmouth students covering web development topics
